courses.subject: BCS
courses.title: First Year Bosnian-Croatian-Serbian I
courses.description: Oral and written work on pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary. For students with no previous study of Bosnian, Croatian or Serbian.

courses.subject: BCS
courses.title: South Slavic Cultures
courses.description: Exploration of South Slavic cultures in the historically rich and complex region sometimes referred to as "the Balkans," focusing particularly on those groups found within the successor states of the former Yugoslavia. Critical look at the traditional view of the region as the crossroads or the bridge between East and West, and at the term Balkanization which has become a pejorative term used to characterize fragmented, and self-defeating social systems.

courses.subject: BCS
courses.title: Second Year Bosnian-Croatian-Serbian I
courses.description: Completion of grammar; written and oral exercises aimed at active command of the language.

courses.subject: BCS
courses.title: Second Year Bosnian-Croatian-Serbian II
courses.description: Selected readings in Bosnian, Croatian, or Serbian literature and culture.

courses.subject: BCS
courses.title: Yugoslavia and After
courses.description: Exploration of the effect of traumatic events, shifting cultural narratives, and social transformations on the construction of collective identities in Bosnia, Croatia and Serbia in the 20th and 21st centuries. Students will read historical and sociological works as well as fiction and poetry.

courses.subject: BCS
courses.title: Third Year Bosnian-Croatian-Serbian I
courses.description: Analysis of the sound system and grammar of the contemporary Bosnian, Croatian, Serbian languages.
courses.prereqText: Knowledge of another Slavic language or consent of instructor.

courses.subject: BCS
courses.title: Third Year Bosnian-Croatian-Serbian II
courses.description: Reading and analysis of selected texts.
